messages:
nina: quick RFC follow-up re: versioning + pin metadata. want a tight contract that lets clients resolve quickly without us shipping lots of fields.

maria: agree. core idea: metadata payload = canonical_version + minimal routing keys + optional telemetry hints blob. clients must be able to operate with just the core keys.

liam: concrete minimal set: model_id, canonical_version, cohort, grace_secs. optional fields: alias_label, release_origin, family_tag inside a 'hints' object clients ignore if unknown.

ops-ryan: ops dependency: routing rules still reference family_tag. during rollout we need a short deprecation window where control plane emits family_tag to preserve rules.

release-bot: deploy: schema-roll-compact v0.3 rolling to 1/6 hosts.

nina: cache guidance: clients SHOULD cache resolver results for 15-60s (default 30s) and must honor grace_secs when deciding to use cached_version.

maria: fallback order when resolver fails or key missing: 1) tenant_pin, 2) cached_version if within grace_secs, 3) default_global_version. document this in resolver_contract.

liam: alias handling: alias_label included only for diagnostics. clients MUST NOT resolve aliases locally; alias->canonical mapping is control-plane only. add an admin API for alias history for infra.

ops-ryan: integrity & partial write detection: control-plane to require meta_crc32 on writes; clients get X-RWMD5 on read responses for optional verification.

nina: decision: adopt compact schema v0.3 with required keys [model_id, canonical_version, cohort, grace_secs], optional 'hints' freeform for legacy fields. publish migration timeline: warnings at 30 days, remove after 120 days.

maria: I'll add validation webhook that returns warnings for deprecated fields, and update RFC notes.

liam: I'll ensure routing rules mirror family_tag during deprecation window and add telemetry when alias mappings change.

ops-ryan: tagging ops to add playbook for forced rollback when caching masks quick rollbacks. recommend adding a short-circuit endpoint to flush resolver caches per-tenant.

nina: thanks all. will edit the RFC with clear examples and a compact JSON snippet for SDK quickstarts. :sparkles:
